_comment: Structured origin facts for prātipadika stems the subanta pipeline cannot derive its own history for (pipelines/subanta.derive() takes a bare stem string, not a Term with provenance). Each entry declares WHERE the stem came from (root + kṛt-pratyaya / samāsa), not a guessed surface property. Consumed by engine/registries/subanta_origin_lookup.py; falls back to bench/ashtadhyayi_gold.py's suffix heuristic only for stems not listed here. See docs/LEXICON_ARCHITECTURE.md.

Satruhan.note: a han-kvip compound (3.2.87), not a mere -han spelling; test_gita_gap_fixes

pitf.note: kinship noun (7.1.94 apavAda), NOT a tfc agent noun despite the -tf spelling -- the suffix-heuristic's own _NOT_TFC exception, declared properly instead of blocklisted

mAtf.note: kinship noun, not tfc -- see pitf
